title: [Demo] Node vs Bun for a new API
user: [Demo conversation — illustrative testing data] For a new API, how should I choose between Node and Bun if stability matters more than speed?
assistant: [Demo conversation — illustrative testing data] Node is a sensible default when a mature ecosystem and compatibility with existing packages matter most. Bun offers an integrated toolchain and may be attractive for speed and developer experience, but check the specific libraries and runtime features your API needs. Try a small prototype and run your tests on the runtime you choose.
